Necessary cookies are required to enable the basic features of this site, such as providing secure log-in or adjusting your consent preferences. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable data.

_**Serge Allaire, head of private equity at Australian pension fund CBUS Super, is set to join Roc Partners, one of the fund’s external investment managers, according to a report by Bloomberg.**_

Allaire has led CBUS’s private equity investments since February 2021, having previously spent eight years as a portfolio manager at MLC Private Equity. CBUS manages more than AUD115bn in assets, with Roc Partners among its private equity managers.

Roc managed approximately AUD468m within CBUS’s default balanced investment option as of 30 June 2026. The firm oversaw AUD713m across the pension fund’s investment options in June 2025, when it was CBUS’s largest external private equity manager.

Allaire reportedly remains at CBUS, and a successor has not been finalised. Roc Partners, which was established in 2014 following a management buyout of Macquarie Investment Management’s private markets division, operates across Sydney, Melbourne and Hong Kong.
